description: Replace the superseded manual deploy.yml with a new standalone .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml that decrypts changed SOPS secrets and syncs them to AWS Secrets Manager (one JSON secret per env), and register the new PLACEHOLDER_ tokens / update the placeholder registry references. Independent of the manifest FEATs at the code level (it touches .github/ and .template/ only), but ordered after FEAT-001/002 so the placeholder registry update can reference every new token those FEATs introduce in one coherent edit.
steps: Create .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml per design.md 'CI sync-secrets workflow': workflow-level on.push {branches:[main], paths:['deploy/k8s/overlays/**/secrets.*.yaml']} and on.pull_request {paths:[same]}; permissions: contents: read with the job adding id-token: write; strategy.matrix.env:[dev,prod].

Steps in sync-secrets.yml: (1) actions/checkout at the same pinned SHA ci.yml uses. (2) Skip-if-absent guard: if deploy/k8s/overlays/<env>/secrets.<env>.yaml does not exist, log 'skipping <env>: no secrets file' and succeed (template default ships only secrets.example.yaml, so this is a no-op on the template). (3) Install sops reproducing deploy.yml's pinned-binary pattern (SOPS_VERSION). (4) aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials at the same pinned SHA deploy.yml used, assuming vars.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN in vars.AWS_REGION, gated `if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` so fork PRs never mutate AWS. (5) Decrypt + extract with mikefarah yq: `sops -d secrets.<env>.yaml | yq -o=json '.stringData // (.data | map_values(@base64d))' > $RUNNER_TEMP/secret.json`; validate the extracted key set equals EXACTLY {DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL}, failing with a message naming the offending key (never its value); then write: run `aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id k8s-fastapi-starter/<env>/app-secrets --secret-string file://$tmp` FIRST, and ONLY on ResourceNotFoundException run `aws secretsmanager create-secret --name k8s-fastapi-starter/<env>/app-secrets --secret-string file://$tmp` (no pre-probe); if put-secret-value returns InvalidRequestException (scheduled for deletion) FAIL with a message to run `aws secretsmanager restore-secret --secret-id …` first. Keep plaintext only in $RUNNER_TEMP, delete on exit, mask, never log values.

Add an IAM code comment above the job: the OIDC role needs secretsmanager:PutSecretValue, secretsmanager:CreateSecret, secretsmanager:DescribeSecret (and RestoreSecret) scoped to arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:k8s-fastapi-starter/*/app-secrets-* in addition to the existing kms:Decrypt for SOPS. Pin all actions to full SHAs reused from ci.yml / the former deploy.yml.

In .template/placeholders.yml: add fill entries for PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_BUCKET, PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_KMS_KEY_ID, PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_ROLE_ARN, PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_IMAGE (listing the files each appears in, per design.md token table); extend PROJECT_SLUG.replace_in with deploy/argocd/** and .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml; change the external AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN and AWS_REGION referenced_in from .github/workflows/deploy.yml to .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml.

Validate the workflow YAML: actionlint .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml if available, else `python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml'))"`; and `pre-commit run check-yaml --files .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml`. Run rg PLACEHOLDER_ and confirm every new PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_* token is present in both a consuming file and the registry, with only intended tokens listed.
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/deploy.yml no longer exists; .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml exists and parses as valid YAML (and passes actionlint if installed).

sync-secrets.yml has workflow-level paths filter on deploy/k8s/overlays/**/secrets.*.yaml, a dev/prod matrix, OIDC id-token: write, the AWS-write steps gated to push-on-main, put-first/create-on-404/fatal-on-InvalidRequestException logic, the exact-key-set validation, and the IAM comment.

.template/placeholders.yml registers the four new PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_* tokens as fill, extends PROJECT_SLUG.replace_in with deploy/argocd/** and the sync-secrets workflow, and updates the external referenced_in to sync-secrets.yml.
rg PLACEHOLDER_ lists only intended tokens and every new token appears in both a consuming file and the registry.
findings: DONE. Deleted .github/workflows/deploy.yml. Created standalone .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml: workflow-level on.push {branches:[main], paths:['deploy/k8s/overlays/**/secrets.*.yaml']} + on.pull_request {paths:[same]}; permissions contents: read with the job adding id-token: write; strategy.matrix.env:[dev,prod] (fail-fast: false so dev/prod are independent). Steps: checkout (pinned 3d3c42e5... v7, reused from ci.yml); skip-if-absent guard (step id=guard sets present=false and succeeds when deploy/k8s/overlays/<env>/secrets.<env>.yaml is absent — the template default, so this is a no-op on the template); install sops (SOPS_VERSION 3.13.3, same pinned-binary pattern as the former deploy.yml); configure-aws-credentials (pinned e1253824... v6.3.0, reused from deploy.yml) assuming vars.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN in vars.AWS_REGION, gated `github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` so fork PRs never mutate AWS; decrypt+validate+sync step using mikefarah yq `sops -d "$SECRET_FILE" | yq -o=json '.stringData // (.data | map_values(@base64d))'` (mikefarah @base64d operator, preinstalled on ubuntu-latest — no install step), masks extracted values via ::add-mask::, validates the sorted key set equals EXACTLY ["DATABASE_URL","REDIS_URL"] failing with ::error:: naming the offending/missing key (never its value), exits 0 after validation on non-push/non-main (PR dry-run, no AWS), then put-secret-value FIRST and ONLY on ResourceNotFoundException create-secret (no pre-probe), with InvalidRequestException (scheduled-for-deletion) FATAL instructing `aws secretsmanager restore-secret` first, and any other AWS error fatal (no values logged). Secret id k8s-fastapi-starter/<env>/app-secrets via SECRET_ID env. IAM code comment in the file header: OIDC role needs secretsmanager:PutSecretValue/CreateSecret/DescribeSecret/RestoreSecret scoped to arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:k8s-fastapi-starter/*/app-secrets-* in addition to kms:Decrypt. All actions full-SHA pinned with version comment (Dependabot keeps in sync). plaintext kept only in $RUNNER_TEMP with a `trap 'rm -f' EXIT`. .template/placeholders.yml: the four PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_* fill tokens were already registered by FEAT-002 (BACKUP_BUCKET, BACKUP_IMAGE, BACKUP_KMS_KEY_ID, BACKUP_ROLE_ARN; plus BACKUP_KMS_ALIAS) — left intact; extended PROJECT_SLUG.replace_in with deploy/argocd/** and .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml; changed the external AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN and AWS_REGION referenced_in from .github/workflows/deploy.yml to .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml (and updated AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN description for the new sync-secrets purpose). VERIFICATION: actionlint not installed locally; `uv run python -c yaml.safe_load` parses sync-secrets.yml and placeholders.yml; `uvx pre-commit run check-yaml --files .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml` Passed; `rg PLACEHOLDER_` lists only intended tokens and every token appears in both a consuming file and the registry (the sync-secrets workflow itself holds no PLACEHOLDER token — the secret id uses the literal PROJECT_SLUG k8s-fastapi-starter, now covered by replace_in).
